classification: D engineering implementation of frozen module contracts; not evidence of H3 generation quality

status_model.validation: pass/fail/unverified apply only to stated scope
status_model.overall: unverified unless a blocking failure exists
status_model.stale: changed dependencies require review; previous evidence retained

routing_budget: No hidden agent recursion or automatic retries. Return missing information or conflicts to the named owner.
consumer_registration: M5State.consumers can register external modules and M5.1—M5.4 results. Only explicit read_paths propagate staleness; listed potential consumers are not automatic dependencies.
